caption: 「兩個人？你們這隊只有兩個人？」
scene: A registration desk at a hackathon venue, a bored young staffer holding a clipboard and staring in disbelief, while a man in his 40s with messy curly hair, round glasses and a navy blue hoodie with a small ladybug pin stands in front of him, and a young man in his 20s with messy hair and round glasses nervously bites a rice ball behind him, harsh fluorescent lighting, wide shot, comic exaggeration.

caption: 「網紅來黑客松？作秀吧。」
scene: A young woman with a short black bob haircut and grey hoodie sits at a cluttered desk covered in sticky notes, not looking up from her laptop, cold dismissive expression, the man in the navy blue hoodie stands beside her looking awkward, the young man with the rice ball backs away three steps in the background, cool blue indoor lighting, medium shot.

caption: 「老人隊？開玩笑的啦，加油喔。」
scene: A neighboring team's table packed with three high-end laptops, two large monitors and a humming mini server, a smug young competitor with a baseball cap leans over and smirks, while the two-person team's tiny setup with one laptop and a convenience store coffee cup looks pathetic in comparison, bright hall lights, wide shot, strong contrast.

caption: 「我們做一個三秒揪出深偽的照妖鏡。」
scene: A whiteboard with a hand-drawn magnifying glass sketch, the man in the navy blue hoodie writes with a marker, determined grin, a small glowing cyan translucent blonde girl in an oversized white hoodie floats beside his shoulder pointing excitedly, the young man with round glasses rolls up his sleeves resignedly, warm spotlight, dynamic angle.

caption: 【叮！綜合判定：深偽，真實度 6%】
scene: A smartphone screen glowing red with warning frames circling a face on a video, the man in the navy blue hoodie holds the phone up calmly on stage, the hologram girl pumps her fist in the air beside him, a crowd of hackers leans forward in shock, dramatic red and cyan lighting, close-up on the phone.

caption: 「這是我本人的演講！」「老闆……那是 AI 生的……」
scene: A pompous older man with slicked grey hair in a three-piece suit turns red-faced and furious on stage, his assistant cowering and confessing, the audience erupting in laughter, one person dropping a phone, a livestream chat scrolling wildly on a side screen, chaotic bright stage lighting, wide comedic shot.

caption: 「照妖鏡不能是我的。它要是大家的。」
scene: The man in the navy blue hoodie stands on stage with a single line of code projected behind him, soft warm light on his face, the young woman with the short black bob haircut in the back row freezes with her fingers hovering over her keyboard, eyes glistening, quiet emotional atmosphere, medium shot.

caption: 【叮！那個人臉部真實度——零趴！】
scene: A dark venue entrance at night, a tall man in a white suit with a flawless porcelain-like waxy smile hands over a business card, the man in the navy blue hoodie holds it with a chill in his fingertips, the hologram girl's translucent cyan form glitches and cracks with alarm, eerie cold streetlight, low angle, ominous mood.
